title: Kroger Reviews Scraper
description: Collect public customer reviews from one or more Kroger product URLs.

startUrls.title: Kroger product URLs
startUrls.description: One or more Kroger product page URLs. Product URLs may include fulfillment or other query parameters.

keywordReview.title: Review keyword filter
keywordReview.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter applied to reviewText.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to save across all supplied products.

max_pages.title: Maximum review pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of 64-review API pages to request for each product.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for stable access on cloud runs.
